title: Screen resolution looks wrong
symptom: Everything on screen looks stretched, blurry or too big
user_description: Since I plugged my laptop into the meeting room screen, everything looks huge and blurry. It's still like that at my desk.

options.why: Far too drastic for a display setting. Never start with the most destructive fix.
Costly and unneeded. The screen worked before, so the hardware is not the problem.

options.text: Open Display settings and set the resolution to the one marked Recommended
options.why: Connecting a different screen often changes the resolution. The Recommended setting matches the screen and gives the sharpest picture.
Wasteful. The monitor worked perfectly until the setting changed.

hints: What changed just before the problem started?
Where in Windows do you change how the picture is displayed?
real_world_tip: If the screen looks blurry after you set the resolution, check the scale setting too. It controls how large text and icons appear.
